verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a web portal with public APIs, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only search, data APIs and account and API-key access, with nothing on an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
